title: Inlet Beach "Somewhere in the Sun" 15 Pompano Street
h1: Inlet Beach "Somewhere in the Sun" 15 Pompano Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Community pool*This pool cannot be heated*- Propane Grill- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Good times await at Somewhere in the Sun, a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Inlet Beach home that accommodates 10 guests. Picture sun-kissed days surrounded by towering dunes and unblemished beaches. Start each morning with fresh pastries from the Donut Hole, a local must-visit, and don’t forget to explore the snorkel reef before heading over to Inlet Beach Shoppes for souvenir browsing. With an unbeatable location—seconds from the community pool and only a 2-minute stroll from the shoreline—guests looking for an unforgettable beach vacation are sure to fall in love.The first level of this 3-floor modern beach home features a mix of inviting sleeping accommodations, including two guest bedrooms—the first has a king bed and a private bathroom, while the second has a queen bed. There’s also a kid-friendly bunk area with a twin-over-twin bunk, a sofa, and a TV. For convenience, a stacked washer and dryer are on the first level.Sunlit shiplap walls and fashionably weathered hardwoods make up the main living spaces on the second level. The kitchen is a chef’s delight with gorgeous countertops, high-end appliances, and a spacious island that doubles as a breakfast bar for 3—perfect for gathering over morning coffee or entertaining guests while whipping up meals and snacks. A few steps past is the wood dining table with 4 chairs and a long bench. In the living space, 2 soft white sofas and 2 pistachio green armchairs offer comfortable seating for watching TV or catching up. Venture onto the balcony for a blissful afternoon sipping chilled sweet tea at the 4-seat, high-top table while enjoying views of the shimmering Gulf.On the top level, guests will find a primary bedroom and a guest bedroom. Both have a king bed and private bathrooms, with the primary bedroom boasting a private balcony. Enjoy Gulf views and quick beach access at Somewhere in the Sun in Inlet Beach. Parking for 3 vehicles makes exploring easy, or guests can cruise around on the 4 complimentary adult bikes. Inlet Beach Regional Access is at the end of South Orange Street. Book this beautiful home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Main Living Area: Living Room, Dining Room, Kitchen, and Half BathTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
